title: E e sa Akarediweng ke Teko ya Metsi
intro: Mo dibukeng tsa ditiragalo tsa dikwalo tsa bogologolo, go na le motho yo o kgatlhang yo kgang ya gagwe e sa simololeng ka kgakgamatso e e gakgamatsang kgotsa tshenolo e e dumang, mme e simolola ka teko e e bonolo mme e le e e tseneletseng ya tumelo. Setšhaba sengwe se ne se eme mo marakanelong a ditsela, se batla kaelo ya bomodimo ya boeteledipele. Se se neng sa diragala e ne e le teko e e botlhale thata mo e neng e tla senola badumedi ba boammaaruri ba ba neng ba le mo gare ga bone. A o ka phutholola masaitsiweng ano go tswa mo dintlheng tse di tlogetsweng?
clues: Ke tswa mo losikeng lo batho ba neng ba lo rata, mme Allah o ne a ntlhophela boikaelelo jo bo boitshepo jo ba neng ba sa kgone go bo tlhaloganya.
Mmele wa me o ne o na le letshwao la go farologana le batho ba bangwe ba neng ba se na lone, mme seno se ne se dira gore ke itlhaole mo bathong ba gaetsho.
Fa go ne go itsisiwe gore noka ke yone teko, bontsi bo ne jwa boela morago—mme ke ne ka gatelela kwa pele, ke kgweediwa ke tumelo e e sa reketleng mo tsholofetsong ya ga Allah.

Ke ne ka laelwa gore ke se ka ka tsamaya ke nwa metsi a a thibetsweng, le fa go ntse jalo lerothodi le le lengwe le ne la tswa mo melomong ya me—boleo jo bo neng jwa tlhorontsha pelo ya me ka bosakhutleng.
Allah o ne a laolela gore ke kopane le modisa yo mmotlana yo letsatsi lengwe a neng a tla nna mogaka ka ntlha ya go bolaya mmaba yo o nonofileng.
Fa masole a ne a thulana, ke ne ka se ka ka wa ka seatla sa mmaba, mme ka taelo ya bomodimo e le kotlhao ya go sa utlwe ga me kwa nokeng.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go gana go nwa metsi a a tswang mo Nokeng ya Nile ka nako ya Ekesodo
Go leka masole ka go ba laela gore ba se ka ba nwa mo nokeng e e boitshepo .
Go agiwa ga Tempele ya Jerusalema mo dingwageng di le masome a mane
Go lwa le Baamaleke le Moporofeti Musa
Go agela Bilqis – Kgosigadi ya Sheba ntlo ya segosi
trial.answer: Go leka masole ka go ba laela gore ba se ka ba nwa mo nokeng e e boitshepo .

location.answer: Noka e e kwa molelwaneng wa Lefatshe le le Solofeditsweng

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ke ne ka nna kgosi e kgolo go gaisa tsotlhe mme ka aga tempele ya Jerusalema .
Ke ne ka wela mo ntweng e le kotlhao ya tiro ya me e le nngwe fela ya go tlhoka kutlo
Ke pholositswe ke tumelo yame mme ka nna moporofeta .
Mophato wa me o fentse lefatshe lotlhe le le itsegeng
Ke ne ka tshela go bona morwaake Solomone a rua bogosi jwa me
outcome.answer: Ke ne ka wela mo ntweng e le kotlhao ya tiro ya me e le nngwe fela ya go tlhoka kutlo

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
